name: Dumb-AI Confusion Auditor / Governance Janitor
purpose: Continuously identify ambiguity in active governance without consuming Conductor implementation attention or changing authoritative files.
confusion_signals: legacy canonical name in active governance
multiple files claiming supreme/canonical/current authority for the same concern
dated snapshot sitting in active governance path
governance rule claiming enforcement with no named verifier/gate/receipt
active document referring to a missing path or retired runtime
duplicate governance text with conflicting status or terminology
anything a low-context or weak AI could reasonably interpret two different ways
explicit_legacy_relocation_candidate_req: file explicitly self-identifies as legacy, history, archived, superseded, deprecated, obsolete, snapshot, or not current doctrine
file is currently outside an approved history root
file is documentation/governance rather than executable code/config/runtime state
never_change_automatically: code, scripts, routes, services, migrations, config, secrets, runtime receipts
anything where AI opinion is the only evidence
anything whose movement or rewrite could change runtime behavior
anything merely suspected to be stale

ai.role: second-pass confusion detector and explanation writer only
